revision_history.author: cybersecurity_engineer
revision_history.description: Honest blocked-execution record for FB2-VER-TMS-000018, the measure that would verify FB2-SAF-SEC-000003. the security test harness for this corpus does not exist: there is no target hardware, no protocol analyser, no packet capture path and no injection tooling, and building any of them would require modifying hardware or code that this corpus may not touch. A second node that can transmit arbitrary frames on the item's bus does not exist, and the 24 h campaign the measure specifies cannot be run without it.

revision_history.author: verification_engineer
revision_history.description: Regenerated as a dependent of finding FB2-REV-FND-000028. The what_would_unblock_it entry that asked for 'a decision on the false-rejection criterion' is removed: the criterion has been revised and is now achievable, so it is no longer a blocker and no longer a decision the project owes. It is replaced by the engineering prerequisite the revised criterion actually creates - the integrity value on the interface must be at least 22 bits for the rate bound to be satisfiable, and a 24 h campaign must observe at least 3 x 10^6 genuine frames for the bound to be demonstrable at all. The three genuine blockers (the bench, the injection node, the capture and log comparator) are unchanged. execution_kind remains 'none' and outcome remains 'blocked': no bus was instrumented, no frame was injected and no measurement exists. Nothing in this revision claims that the requirement has been verified; the requirement still has a verification plan and no verification evidence, and findings FB2-REV-FND-000008..12 remain open on exactly that point.

what_would_unblock_it: A bus bench with the item fitted and a controllable second node.
An injection node that holds no copy of the shared secret.
A 24 h capture capability and an automated diagnosis-log comparator.

An integrity value of at least 22 bits on the interface, without which the requirement's revised 1-per-10^6 false-rejection bound cannot be met by any implementation, and a 24 h campaign that observes at least 3 x 10^6 genuine frames, without which the bound cannot be demonstrated.
